text:
I need to verify the nationality of Hans Christian Andersen (note the correct spelling is "Andersen" not "Anderson").

Hans Christian Andersen (1805-1875) was a Danish author and poet, famous for his fairy tales including "The Little Mermaid," "The Ugly Duckling," and "The Emperor's New Clothes." He was born in Odense, Denmark, and spent most of his life in Denmark.

All four agents correctly identified him as Danish with very high confidence (0.98-1.00), and this is indeed the correct answer.

Answer: Danish
Confidence: 0.99
